form.title: Grant access
form.type_minutes_help: Minutes of actual use. They never expire.
form.type_until_help: Unlimited access until a date. One year from today, at most.
form.step_help: Usage is metered in 5-minute blocks, and granted amounts follow: the minutes field only offers multiples of 5.
form.until_required: Enter the date. A grant with no end date is not allowed.
form.until_past: The date must be in the future.
form.ref_help: Ticket or contract number. Do not write personal data here.

confirm.title: Confirm grant
confirm.permanence: The grant is recorded permanently. Revoking invalidates the row and recalculates the balance — it does not delete the record.
confirm.inert_warning: This user has unlimited access until {date}. The minutes are added to the balance now and are only consumed once the period ends.
confirm.until_stacks_warning: This user already has access until {date}. The new period is added on top of that date — the final date will be later than the one you picked.

result.granted_until_stacked: Granted. Unlimited access until {date} — the period was added to the access that already existed.
result.duplicate: Nothing was granted: this event was already recorded.

revoke.title: Revoke grant
revoke.consumed: {duration} of this grant has already been used.
revoke.effect: Revoking removes both what this grant credited and the usage it paid for. Minutes already used do not come back as balance.
revoke.until_warning: Revoking a period grant does not shorten the period. To end access, change the period through the access-period path.
revoke.reason_help: It is recorded in the ledger, permanently. Do not write personal data.
revoke.not_found: This grant no longer exists. Reload the list.
revoke.already: This grant has already been revoked.

batch.sentence: You are about to grant {duration} ({minutes} minutes) to {count} users.
batch.unlimited_note: {count} of them have unlimited access. For those, the balance is added but stays idle.
batch.until_stacks_note: {count, plural, one {# of them already has an active period} other {# of them already have an active period}}. For those, the new period is added to it.
batch.not_atomic: Each user is granted separately. If one fails, the others continue.
batch.type_to_confirm: The list does not fit on screen. To confirm, type {word}.

errors.forbidden: Your account cannot grant. Talk to a CMS administrator.
errors.no_profile: This user has no app profile. Granting is not possible.
errors.not_multiple: The amount must be a multiple of 5 minutes. The nearest valid values are {lower} and {upper}.
errors.above_cap: Maximum {duration} ({cap} minutes) per grant. To give more, grant again — each grant is its own row in the history.
errors.above_cap_unknown: The amount is over the cap per grant. Reduce it and try again.
errors.period_applied_no_record: The access period was applied and the user already has access. Only the record of the grant failed. Do not grant again: the new period would be added on top of the one that already exists, and revoking does not shorten it. This grant will not appear in the history. The audit log shows who applied it and until when.
errors.unknown: Could not complete. Code {code}. The detail is in the server log.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. The grant may have gone through anyway — check the grant history before trying again.
